Method of Attack: Ransomware as a Service allowing creation of customized ransomware without technical experience
Encrypts configured file extensions and appends .locked extension
Extracts a randomly named executable 'decrypter' into %UserProfile%\AppData\Roaming\Settings
Decryptor program demands victim email and bitcoin payment to specified bitcoin address
Ransomware configuration includes targeted folders, file types, countries, ransom prices, and notification email
Impacted Systems: Windows systems (implied by file paths and executable names)
Attack Vector: Distribution of ransomware executable (Shark.exe) by wannabe criminals
Download from publicly accessible WordPress site
Execution of included Shark.exe executable by victims
Indicators of Compromise: Publicly accessible WordPress site hosting the RaaS
PayloadBundle.zip containing Payload Builder.exe, Readme.txt, Shark.exe
